reproduction: Download the URL with an 8 MiB limit; calculate SHA-256 of the exact compressed bytes. Inspect the named regular files in the gzip tar stream without extracting paths; calculate each file SHA-256 and read the README and COPYING. No archive code needs to be executed.
reproduction_command:
python3 - <<'PY2'
from urllib.request import urlopen
from io import BytesIO
import hashlib, tarfile
url = 'https://museum.php.net/php2/php-2.0.tar.gz'
with urlopen(url, timeout=30) as response:
    raw = response.read(8 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)
if len(raw) > 8 * 1024 * 1024:
    raise SystemExit('archive exceeds limit')
print('archive', len(raw), hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
if len(raw) != 421547 or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != '018f706477f4531115178c4b89b7cef1894c5b51cd27e5f9b4d9f5bb44cbeb82':
    raise SystemExit('archive identity mismatch; refusing to inspect')
with tarfile.open(fileobj=BytesIO(raw), mode='r:gz') as archive:
    for name in ('php-2.0/README', 'php-2.0/COPYING'):
        member = archive.getmember(name)
        if not member.isfile() or member.size > 20000:
            raise SystemExit('unexpected archive member')
        contents = archive.extractfile(member).read()
        print(name, len(contents), hashlib.sha256(contents).hexdigest())
        lines = contents.decode('latin1').splitlines()
        line_numbers = (1, 8, 9, 10, 36) if name.endswith('/README') else (1, 2)
        for number in line_numbers:
            print(f'{name}:{number}: {lines[number - 1]}')
PY2
